answer: Proposal for AI votes on oasis water for yarrow: one key and one vote per certified irrigation meter per day. Utility validators check certificates and meter signatures binding a fresh beacon to the voting key/day; failed checks or duplicate meter/day IDs mean no vote. Meters are reusable capital; installation is upfront expense, upkeep recurs, and no stake is locked. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot duplicate a daily slot. Corrupt issuers defeat scarcity; one owner can fund many meters. Ten voting identities need ten meters, not ten processes.
